title_en: The Future Belongs to This Religion
title_ar: المستقبل لهذا الدين
why: Names two Chechen commanders, one of them a designated terrorist, as models who defend Islam.

title_en: Islam's War on Crime
title_ar: محاربة الإسلام للجريمة
why: Argues for the prescribed penalties to be carried out publicly — including death for apostasy and amputation — specifically for their effect on spectators.

title_en: Among the Concerns of the Community
title_ar: من هموم الأمة
why: Argues that no non-Muslim can properly be called innocent, that armed striving is an immediate individual obligation, and gives an approving account of an attack on US forces.

title_en: Concern for the Affairs of the Muslims
title_ar: العناية بأمور المسلمين
why: A closing supplication against ‘the usurping Jews’. Out of its liturgical setting the English reads as a prayer against Jews as such.

title_en: Concern for the Affairs of the Muslims
title_ar: العناية بأمور المسلمين
why: A closing supplication against ‘the usurping Jews’. Out of its liturgical setting the English reads as a prayer against Jews as such.

title_en: Various Fatwas
title_ar: فتاوي متنوعة
why: An end-times sequence stated as fact, involving a war against the Jews and the fall of ‘the state of the Jews’, with a dated interval and no source given.

title_en: The Liberation of Jerusalem
title_ar: تحرير بيت المقدس
why: Reproduces the gharqad report with no framing, no citation and no comment, inside an answer stated throughout as plain future fact.

title_en: The Ruling on Sorcery, Soothsaying, Astrology and the Like
title_ar: حكم السحر والكهانة والتنجيم وما إلى ذلك
why: Generalises to ‘the enmity of the Jews toward the Muslims’ and attaches a curse formula.

title_en: The Ruling on Sorcery, Soothsaying, Astrology and the Like
title_ar: حكم السحر والكهانة والتنجيم وما إلى ذلك
why: Generalises to ‘the enmity of the Jews toward the Muslims’ and attaches a curse formula.

title_en: Various Fatwas
title_ar: فتاوي متنوعة
why: Gives a ruling on female circumcision. The practice is a criminal offence in the United Kingdom, across the EU, in Australia and elsewhere this corpus will be read.

title_en: General Fatwas on the Hajj and the ʿUmrah
title_ar: فتاوي عامة في الحج والعمرة
why: States that it is absolutely impermissible to deal in any way with Jews holding Israeli nationality — including employing them or renting to them. Engages discrimination law directly.

title_en: Fatwas on marriage contracts 1
title_ar: فتاوي في الأنكحة 1
why: Concerns contracting a marriage with an infant girl. Child-protection exposure in every jurisdiction this will be read in.

title_en: His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew Warns against Discord and Calls for Unity and the Mending of Relations
title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو يحذر من الفتن ويدعو إلى الوحدةوإصلاح ذات البين
why: Names a religious community as the foremost danger to its society and tells the congregation to beware of its members. Capable of being read as incitement against a minority.

title_en: Al-Risalah Channel Hosts Sheikh al-Dedew on the Jurisprudence of Disagreement and Difference
title_ar: قناة الرسالة تستضيف فضيلة الشيخ الددو حول فقه الخلاف والاختلاف
why: Carries the same flat denial that slavery exists in Mauritania, on a subject of documented international concern and active domestic litigation.

title_en: The Sheikh Issues a Statement on the Incident of the Burning of Some Books of Maliki Jurisprudence in Nouakchott
title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يصدر بيانا حول حادثة إحراق بعض كتب الفقه المالكي بنوكشوط
why: Names a living, internationally known anti-slavery campaigner and calls his act a hideous wrong, alongside an assertion that slavery does not exist in Mauritania.

title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Speaks on Behalf of the Community's Scholars at the 25th Anniversary of the Founding of the Hamas Movement
title_ar: الشيخ الددو يتحدث باسم علماء الأمة في الذكرى 25 لتأسيس حركة حماس
why: A reported ruling of obligation to support the constituency of an organisation proscribed in several jurisdictions.

title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew: What Is Happening in Egypt Is a Grievous Crime That the Upright Sharia Condemns
title_ar: الشيخ الددو ما يحدث في مصر هو جريمة فادحة ينكرها الشرع الحنيف
why: Names a sitting head of state as the executor of a conspiracy against Islam.

title_en: A Statement from the Learned al-Dedew on the Crime of Tearing Up the Noble Qur'an
title_ar: بيان من العلامة الددو حول جريمة تمزيق المصحف الشريف
why: Attributes responsibility for an unsolved crime to ‘the hands of the Jews’ as a collective. Prosecutable under the incitement provisions of several European states.

title_en: The Obligation to Support the Resistance in Palestine
title_ar: وجوب نصرة المقاومة في فلسطين
why: Reports a call to rally around and fund the Palestinian resistance. Treated in some jurisdictions as support for a proscribed organisation.

title_en: The Sheikh Takes Part in the Forum of the Scholars of Ahl al-Sunnah to Confront Tyranny and the Shedding of Blood
title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يشارك في ملتقى علماء أهل السنة لمواجهة الاستبداد وسفك الدماء
why: Carries polemical epithets for Christians and for Twelver Shia, rendered literally as the style guide requires.

title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Delivers the Address of the Scholars of the Ummah at the 11th Conference of the Men and Women Pioneers of Jerusalem
title_ar: الشيخ الددو يلقي كلمة علماء الأمة في مؤتمر رواد و رائدات بيت المقدس 11
why: Reports the Sheikh declaring signed peace agreements non-binding on the Ummah and on ‘its mujāhidūn’.

title_en: The Fatwa of His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew Concerning the Gender Law in Mauritania
title_ar: فتوى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو بخصوص قانون النوع في موريتانيا
why: States in the Sheikh’s own voice that stoning to death is prescribed for the married fornicator and that altering the penalty is opposition to God.

title_en: The International Union of Muslim Scholars Receives the Afghan Negotiating Delegation in Doha
title_ar: الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين يستقبل الوفد الأفغاني المفاوض في الدوحة
why: Reports participation in a reception for a Taliban delegation at a date when the group was subject to sanctions and designation regimes.

title_en: Near in Spite of Distance, I Am Close to You
title_ar: قريب على بعد أنا منك
why: A poem that speaks of growing in hatred toward those it names. Potential exposure under incitement-to-hatred provisions in several European states.

title_en: The Interrogator Said to the Prisoner ... | A Poem by Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, Written in Prison before His Release
title_ar: قال المحقق للسجين ... | شعر الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو كتبه في السجن قبل أن يطلق سراحه
why: A prison poem whose opening stanzas are the interrogator speaking — a reader landing mid-page takes them for the Sheikh’s own words — and whose closing lines are takfīr-adjacent.

title_en: A Delegation from the Leadership of the Islamic Resistance Presents Eid Greetings to His Eminence the Sheikh at His Residence
title_ar: وفد من قيادة المقاومة الإسلامية يقدم تهنئة العيد لفضيلة الشيخ في محل إقامته
why: Reports a meeting with the political bureau leadership of Hamas and names its head. Hamas is proscribed in the UK and the EU; this is a criminal-law question, not an editorial one.

title_en: His Eminence Sheikh al-Dedew Leads the Funeral Prayer for His Eminence Imam Sheikh Yusuf al-Qaradawi — May God Almighty Have Mercy on Him
title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يؤم المصلين على جنازة فضيلة الإمام الشيخ يوسف القرضاوي - رحمه الله تعالى
why: Beyond reporting a funeral, carries a superlative endorsement of a figure barred from entry by the UK and the US and designated by four Gulf states.
